corrosion.title: Corrosion and the infrastructure options
corrosion.summary: Salt from the sea corrodes steel and aluminium, so the materials go by how far the site is from the shore (OTE’s instruction, from AS 4312).
corrosion.intro: Salt carried inland from the sea corrodes galvanised steel and aluminium far faster than inland air does. AS 4312:2019, Atmospheric corrosivity zones in Australia, grades a site’s air from C1 (very low) to CX (extreme), mostly by how far it is from the sea and how rough that sea is. OTE groups those grades into three categories, each with its own materials, and sets the distances for each kind of shore. The tool follows OTE’s instruction; where its distances differ from the standard’s own table, both are shown below.
corrosion.source: OTE’s instruction (November 2026), based on AS 4312:2019 Atmospheric corrosivity zones in Australia. The standard’s Table 4.1 as reproduced in Timber Queensland Technical Data Sheet 35 (April 2020).

shores.label: Temperate quiet
shores.about: Enclosed bays and estuaries with almost no waves, such as Port Phillip Bay and the Derwent. The suggestion counts none of Queensland’s coast as this: its sheltered water is taken as semi-sheltered, the safer side.

shores.label: Temperate semi-sheltered
shores.about: Bays and gulfs with small waves. In Queensland, south of the Tropic of Capricorn, every shore that isn’t a surf beach: Moreton Bay, the Broadwater, Pumicestone Passage, the Great Sandy Strait, Hervey Bay and the river mouths.

shores.label: Tropical quiet
shores.about: Tropical coasts sheltered from ocean swell. In Queensland, the whole coast north of the Tropic of Capricorn (it reaches the coast near Rockhampton): behind the Great Barrier Reef, Torres Strait and the Gulf of Carpentaria.

shores.label: Surf
shores.about: Open ocean beaches with breaking surf. In Queensland: the Gold Coast, the ocean side of South and North Stradbroke, Moreton and Bribie Islands, the Sunshine Coast, Cooloola, K’gari’s ocean beach, and Bundaberg to Agnes Water.

bands.name: C5 and CX
bands.materials: Stainless steel tower, enclosure and orifice run.

bands.name: C4
bands.materials: Standard galvanised tower, with a stainless steel enclosure and orifice run.

otherwise.name: C3 and below
otherwise.materials: Standard galvanised tower, aluminium enclosure and galvanised orifice run. In a polluted river, a stainless steel orifice run: tick it, and the choice becomes Custom.

standard.title: AS 4312:2019 Table 4.1
standard.about: The standard’s own table: the corrosivity grade at each distance from the shoreline, for each kind of shore.
footnotes: * Reduce to C2 where the site is more than 50 m above sea level and more than 5 km from the shoreline.
A split grade (CX/C5, C5/C4) is compared at its higher grade.
The shoreline is not accurately defined; in critical applications take it as the high tide line.

grades.name: Very low
grades.text: Inside heated or air-conditioned buildings with clean air; some semi-sheltered places far from the sea or industry.

grades.name: Low
grades.text: Dry, rural areas and other areas remote from the coast or pollution. Most of Australia at least 50 km from the coast.

grades.name: Medium
grades.text: Mainly coastal areas with low salinity.

grades.name: Very high
grades.text: Normally 50 m to 500 m inland from coasts exposed to surf or very rough seas.

grades.name: Extreme
grades.text: Offshore structures, and within 50 m inland of coasts exposed to surf or very rough seas.

notes: Measure to the shoreline at high tide. A river bank upstream of the mouth is not the shoreline: the distance is to the sea.
Local conditions can push a site up a category: strong onshore winds over flat ground, spray from a nearby headland, industry nearby, or a polluted river. If in doubt, take the higher category.
corrosion.how: When the site’s position is known (its Instrumentation Coordinates, or the new location when the station is being relocated), the page measures the distance to the sea on QSpatial’s Queensland coastline: to the nearest surf beach, and to the nearest other shore, which counts as tropical quiet north of the Tropic of Capricorn and temperate semi-sheltered south of it. The highest category any of them reaches is filled in as a Map suggestion, orange until you check it. Outside Queensland, choose it yourself from the table.
